title: SITAR: A Situational Distortion Metric for Automatic Speech Recognition Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.21440v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In automatic speech recognition (ASR), transcription errors with similar lexical or semantic discrepancies can have markedly different consequences for the situation conveyed by speech. Capturing these differences requires not merely contextual assessment, but an understanding of what the spoken discourse describes, establishes, or seeks to bring about. However, relying on LLM judges introduces computational cost and scoring variability. We introduce SITAR, a situational distortion metric for ASR, realized through a comprehensive end-to-end construction framework. Specifically, this framework aggregates situational severity and cumulative extent into a unified score via a bounded recursive formulation. translated_title: SITAR：一种用于自动语音识别评估的情境失真度量
translated_abstract: 在自动语音识别（ASR）中，具有相似词汇或语义差异的转录错误可能对语音所传达的情境产生截然不同的后果。捕捉这些差异不仅需要上下文层面的评估，还需要对口语话语所描述、确立或试图达成的内容的理解。然而，依赖大语言模型（LLM）作为评判者会引入计算成本和评分的不稳定性。我们提出了SITAR，一种面向ASR的情境失真度量，通过一个全面的端到端构建框架实现。具体而言，该框架通过一个有界递归公式将情境严重程度和累积范围聚合为统一分数。基于该公式推导出的训练目标（仅需有限的离线LLM支持），我们将SITAR训练为一个轻量级的BERT系列回归器，能够在单次前向传播中对参考-假设对进行评分，完全避免了任何高昂的运行时成本。
tldr: SITAR提出了一种用于自动语音识别评估的情境失真度量，通过有界递归公式将情境严重程度与累积范围聚合为统一分数，并训练为轻量级BERT回归器，在单次前向传播中即可完成评分，避免了运行时依赖LLM评判带来的高昂计算成本和评分不稳定性。
en_tdlr: SITAR introduces a situational distortion metric for ASR that aggregates situational severity and cumulative extent via a bounded recursive formulation, trained with limited offline LLM support as a lightweight BERT-family regressor scoring reference-hypothesis pairs in a single forward pass, eliminating the prohibitive runtime cost and scoring variability of LLM judges.
